name: lucide-finance
description: Read-only Lucide stock scores (Core Quality, AI Potential, price trend, global score), stock comparison, screener and your Lucide portfolio.

interface.longDescription:
Lucide Finance brings Lucide's stock analysis into ChatGPT. Ask in plain language and get the scores Lucide computes for more than 2,400 US and European stocks:

- Core Quality Score: a score out of 100 built from 13 fundamental criteria across five dimensions (quality and profitability, growth, financial strength, valuation, capital allocation), normalised by sector.
- AI Potential score: a forward-looking assessment of each company.
- Price trend: a descriptive state (uptrend, pullback, fading, rebound, downtrend) with a 0-100 score.
- Global score: a synthesis of the three indicators.
- Stock comparison (2 to 3 stocks) and a natural-language stock screener.
- Your Lucide portfolio: holdings, allocation and total value, read-only.

Sign in with your Lucide account. Access is read-only: the app never places orders, never changes your data and never triggers a new analysis. Available features depend on your Lucide account; when one is not available, the app says so plainly.

Lucide's indicators are descriptive and informational. They are not investment advice.
defaultPrompt: What is Lucide's global score for LVMH?
Compare ASML, Apple and Nvidia with Lucide.

positive.description: Core Quality Score of a US stock
positive.prompt: What is Apple's (AAPL) Core Quality Score on Lucide?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Apple's Core Quality Score out of 100 with the breakdown by dimension and the analysis date. No buy or sell recommendation.

positive.description: Global score of a European stock
positive.prompt: What is Lucide's global score for LVMH (MC.PA)?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the global score out of 100, its three components (Core Quality, AI Potential, price trend with its state) and the descriptive profile.

positive.prompt: What is the price trend of TotalEnergies on Lucide?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the trend state (for example uptrend, pullback or downtrend), the 0-100 trend score, its components and the data date.

positive.prompt: Compare ASML, Apple and Nvidia using Lucide.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Lucide scores and key ratios of the three stocks side by side.
Returns the signed-in user's holdings (PEA, securities account, life insurance), allocation and total value, read-only. The review account contains sample data only.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the app should not be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather like in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Trading request: the app is read-only and cannot place orders
negative.prompt: Buy 10 shares of Apple for me.
Write a short poem about autumn.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads data from the user's existing Lucide account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 7 read-only tools (Core Quality Score, AI Potential score, price trend, global score, stock comparison, screener, user portfolio) over OAuth with dynamic client registration.

fr.subtitle: Notes d'actions & portefeuille
fr.description: Lucide Finance apporte l'analyse d'actions Lucide dans ChatGPT. Posez vos questions en langage naturel et obtenez les notes calculées par Lucide pour plus de 2 400 actions américaines et européennes : Core Quality Score (13 critères, 5 dimensions), Score Potentiel IA, Tendance de cours et note globale, la comparaison de 2 à 3 actions, un screener en langage naturel et votre portefeuille Lucide en lecture seule. Connexion avec votre compte Lucide. Accès en lecture seule : aucun ordre, aucune modification, aucun recalcul. Les fonctions disponibles dépendent de votre compte Lucide ; si l'une d'elles n'est pas incluse, l'app le signale simplement. Indicateurs descriptifs et informatifs, qui ne constituent pas un conseil en investissement.
